questions.text: Define data science and its need.
List any five applications of data science.
State the purpose of setting a research goal in the data science process.
Illustrate a data transformation for a simple example.
Explain the concept of handling missing values with a suitable example.
Explain exploratory data analysis and its purpose.
Name the Python modules used in the data science process with their purpose.
Describe the purpose of data modeling in the data science process.
Explain the relation between probability and statistics.
Differentiate between descriptive and inferential statistics.
Distinguish between null hypothesis and alternative hypothesis with examples.
Calculate the standard error of the mean for the following dataset: 12, 14, 16, 18.

a.text: Explain the stages of the data science process with a neat diagram.

b.text: Describe the steps involved in the data preparation phase and compare cleaning with transformation.

a.text: Apply min-max normalization and z-score standardization to the data 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 and interpret the results.

parts.text: Compute the mean and variance of the sample 10, 12, 14, 16.
Analyze the effect of an outlier on the mean and the median of the same sample.

a.text: Evaluate the suitability of random sampling versus stratified sampling for a student survey and justify your answer.

b.text: Design an end-to-end data science workflow to predict student performance from academic data.
